command.mac: In each repo checkout named below on this Mac, run `git fetch origin --prune`. For each listed branch, print whether `git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/<branch> origin/main` is true. Show me all the outputs before any delete. Then for each branch whose tip is an ancestor of origin/main, run `git push origin --delete <branch>` in its own repo and print the result. If a branch is not an ancestor, or is not on origin, delete nothing for it and tell me. Touch no other branch. One exception, claude-settings saved-comment-owner-cut: it is not on main, so for it print `git rev-parse origin/saved-comment-owner-cut` and `git rev-parse origin/archive/saved-comment-owner-cut`, and only if both equal f30f077ab8dad2533503cd2dc024a55909caf192 run `git push origin --delete saved-comment-owner-cut` (its archive copy is the archive/ branch; never delete the archive branch). Branches: claude-settings: silent-undo-r2-tests, saved-comment-owner-cut. q_max: claude/int-batch-qmax-r5. banchi: claude/ci-rebalance. degen: degen-harness-flake-archiver-stop-fix, child-ci-degen-push-skip, claude/pin-upgrade. home: ci-done-zizmor, ci-claude-settings-at-stable. Report each branch and its result.

context:
Goal: stale remote branches that main already holds are gone, with nothing lost.
Problem (cannot undo): the cloud refuses remote branch deletes, so a session on your Mac must run them. A delete cannot be undone, but a branch whose last commit is on main loses no work: main is its archive copy (the standing grant covers exactly that branch kind). The prompt checks that first and deletes nothing otherwise.

short: Mac: delete nine merged remote branches
steps: Open a Claude Code session on your Mac with your claude-settings, q_max, banchi, degen and home checkouts reachable (start it in one and name the other paths when it asks).
Paste the command below and send it. It prints the ancestor check for every branch first, then deletes only the branches that main already holds.
Paste its reply into this item's note box, then press Done. Triage relays it to runner 11 and the coordinator.
title: Paste one prompt into a Mac session to delete nine remote branches that main or an archive branch already holds
why: The cloud refuses remote branch deletes; only a session on your Mac can run them.
